name: web-scraper
description: Asynchronous web scraper: NestJS API + BullMQ worker and a React frontend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix backend run test:cov && npm --prefix frontend run test:cov
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:all
